job.title: Programme Support Office
job.description:
Programme Support Officer

This is a wonderful 3 month temp contract which has every chance of being extended. The environment is very respectful and encouraging.
You can work hybrid ( 2 days in the office a week) - £ 21.20 per hour
Fully remote - £ 18.90 per hour
A wonderful opportunity especially if you have local government / local council experience.

As part of the Improvement Coordination and Strategy Team, you will provide administrative support for the Partnerships and Improvement functions.

Core Accountabilities:

  1. Organise and support meetings, events and functions.
  2. Maintain and continuously improve administrative systems, including forward/project plans, electronic filing systems, CRM mailing lists and databases.
  3. Produce reports, briefings and information sheets and update the website and portal.
  4. Arrange room bookings, refreshments, printing, copying, distribution, travel and other administrative tasks in support of the team.
  5. Contribute to the delivery of the team’s agreed objectives.
  6. Participate in relevant projects that support the delivery of the Business Plan.
  7. Model values and work in accordance with health and safety, equal opportunities and environmental policies.
  8. Undertake any other duties and responsibilities appropriate to the post.



Specific Accountabilities:

  1. Provide comprehensive support to the Partnerships and Improvement Directorate function
  2. Support the resourcing of peer support including the recruitment, accreditation, placement, performance review and development of member and officer peers, establishing positive working relations with peers and contributing to the development of streamlined processes.
  3. Provide administrative/project support
  4. Assist in providing direct support to councils and their partners.
  5. Provide comprehensive support in delivering improvement and leadership programmes. Assist the support for local government in the development, commissioning and delivery of services.
  6. Assist with preparation of briefings and surveys and dissemination of research findings to the local government sector and wider.
  7. Undertake and support projects and programmes, developing and maintaining project milestone plans and information systems, preparing agendas and papers and co-ordinating monthly updates.
  8. Manage orders and invoices, expenses, sickness reporting and other Agresso-based activities, in line with agreed finance and HR procedures on behalf of the team.
  9. Undertake any other duties and responsibilities appropriate to the post.



Qualifications
Knowledge and experience

  • Previous administrative experience and knowledge of office systems and procedures, ideally gained in a member services or project based environment.
  • A broad understanding of local and/or central government and how they work.
  • Experience of working within a team environment
  • Experience of a range of software packages including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, e-mail and the internet.
  • Experience of researching data from a range of sources and of compiling clear, comprehensive papers.
  • Experience of organising meetings, events or other activities.
Skills and abilities

  • Excellent written skills, with the ability to accurately summarise and convey complex information.
  • Excellent oral and influencing skills, with the ability to give clear advice on procedural issues.
  • Political sensitivity, with the ability to exercise discretion, judgement and confidentiality when dealing with politicians and officers at every level, and to demonstrate political neutrality at all times.
  • Good interpersonal skills, with the ability to deal with members, other clients and colleagues with courtesy, tact and sensitivity.
  • A demonstrable commitment to customer care.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise work to meet deadlines, and a concern for order and accuracy
  • Excellent IT skills, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint with the ability quickly to learn new packages as required.
  • Good project management and financial control skills
  • Ability to work as part of a team and to support others.
  • Flexible approach to work, with a keenness to adapt to meet changing work requirements
  • A positive, “can do” attitude

job.title: Loan Administration Manager
job.description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Loan Administration Manager to join a growing banking operation in the City of London.

This is a senior operational role responsible for overseeing the end-to-end administration of loan products, ensuring accuracy, regulatory compliance and high service standards across the Loans Administration function.

You will lead and develop the Loans Administration team, oversee loan processing and servicing activity, manage operational risk and act as a key escalation point for complex issues. The role will also provide cover for the Head of Loan Administration when required.

Salary: £75,000–£85,000 + Car Allowance

Location: London – City

Working Pattern: Hybrid – 3 days office / 2 days WFH

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of the Loans Administration function.
  • Oversee loan processing, documentation, servicing, settlements and associated administration.
  • Lead, coach and develop the Loans Administration team, providing ongoing guidance and training.
  • Monitor workloads, performance, KPIs and SLAs to ensure consistent service delivery.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex loan administration queries and operational issues.
  • Ensure loan administration activities comply with internal policies and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain accurate loan records, reporting and operational controls.
  • Work closely with Front Office, Credit, Finance, Treasury and Operations teams.
  • Liaise with Head Office to ensure effective communication, alignment and consistent processes.
  • Work closely with Finance/FRRD on accounting-related matters, including margin changes, backdated deals, P/L adjustments and prepayments.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with external banking and loan administration partners.
  • Support audits and ensure the function remains prepared for regulatory reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements and efficiencies across the Loans Administration function.
  • Manage and actively participate in ad-hoc projects and wider operational initiatives.
  • Provide cover for the Head of Loan Administration during periods of absence, ensuring key tasks, issues and escalations are managed effectively.

Skills/ Experience:

  • At least 5 years' banking experience.
  • Proven experience within loan administration, loan operations or financial services operations.
  • Strong understanding of lending products, loan processing and servicing.
  • Previous team leadership and people management experience.
  • LoanIQ experience – essential.
  • Good working knowledge of SWIFT and Microsoft Office/Excel.
  • Strong understanding of operational risk, controls and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience working closely with Front Office, Credit, Finance, Treasury and other operational teams.

What We're Looking For

This role would suit someone who combines strong technical loan administration expertise with proven leadership capability.

You will need to be comfortable working in a busy banking environment, managing competing priorities and making decisions on complex operational issues. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who can take ownership, identify solutions and drive improvements while maintaining a strong focus on accuracy, risk and compliance.

job.title: Payments SME
job.description:
Payments Consultant (Bacs, Faster Payments & CHAPS)

Remote (UK) | Contract | Financial Services | Initial 6-Month Engagement

Payments Consultant | UK Domestic Payments

We are supporting a major financial services programme and are seeking experienced Payments Consultants with specialist expertise in Bacs, Faster Payments (FPS) and/or CHAPS.

This is a specialist advisory role focused on UK domestic payment schemes, operational processes and implementation considerations. The successful candidate will work closely with Business Analysts, Product Teams, Architects and programme stakeholders, providing expert guidance on how payment schemes operate and what organisations must consider when delivering payment capabilities through a sponsor bank model.

This is not a project management, transformation or delivery leadership role. We are specifically looking for payments professionals with deep scheme knowledge who can advise on operational mechanics, participant obligations and industry best practice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide subject matter expertise across Bacs, Faster Payments and/or CHAPS.
  • Advise stakeholders on scheme mechanics, operating models and implementation considerations.
  • Support discovery, requirements gathering and solution design activities.
  • Provide guidance on sponsor bank and indirect participation models.
  • Review payment solutions and ensure alignment with scheme requirements and industry standards.
  • Support Business Analysts, Product Owners, Architects and technical teams throughout delivery.
  • Explain payment flows, message processing, operational controls and participant responsibilities.
  • Identify risks, dependencies and operational considerations relating to UK domestic payments.
  • Deliver knowledge transfer and specialist guidance to programme stakeholders.

Experience Required

  • Demonstrable expertise in one or more of:
    • Bacs
    • Faster Payments (FPS)
    • CHAPS
  • Experience operating, implementing or supporting UK payment scheme capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of payment processing, scheme rules and settlement processes.
  • Experience advising stakeholders on payments-related business and technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Suitable Backgrounds

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked as:

  • Payments Consultant
  • Senior Payments Consultant
  • Payments SME
  • Payments Product Owner
  • Payments Product Manager
  • Scheme Manager
  • Scheme Product Owner
  • Payments Operations Manager
  • Payments Solution Consultant
  • Payments Implementation Consultant
  • Payments Architect with hands-on scheme experience

Desirable Experience

  • Sponsor bank and indirect participation models.
  • Banking and financial services organisations.
  • Payment platform implementations.
  • Experience with organisations such as Form3, Vocalink, Finastra, ACI Worldwide, Volante, Bottomline, Temenos, ClearBank, Banking Circle or Modulr.
  • Consulting experience within large-scale payments programmes.

Contract Details

  • Role: Payments Consultant
  • Contract Length: Initial 6 months
  • Location: Remote (UK)
  • Engagement Type: Contract
  • Rate: Flexible for the right specialist
  • Extension Potential: Strong
  • Start Date: ASAP

Apply

If you have deep expertise in Bacs, Faster Payments or CHAPS and can demonstrate hands-on experience supporting the implementation, operation or optimisation of UK domestic payment capabilities, we would be keen to hear from you. Apply with your latest CV for immediate consideration.

job.title: Accounts Payable Assistant
job.description:
Location: Central London

Salary: Day Rate £150-£170
Duration: circa 6 months
Working Pattern: Office based for the training period, hybrid working possible after this.
Start Date: End of August/ Beginning of September

Main Duties:

  • Process supplier invoices and employee expenses, ensuring they are correctly authorised, coded and recorded.
  • Maintain an accurate and up-to-date purchase ledger.
  • Act as a key point of contact for suppliers, resolving invoice queries, payment queries and account issues.
  • Work with internal departments to resolve invoice approval delays and wider finance queries.
  • Support the onboarding of new suppliers, including verification checks and account setup.
  • Support the preparation of payment runs, including BACS and CHAPS where appropriate.
  • Reconcile the purchase ledger against bank statements and investigate outstanding or unreconciled items.
  • Support the month-end close, including balance sheet reconciliations and accruals.
  • Assist with the preparation of VAT Returns.

Skills/Experience required:

  • A minimum of 5 years' experience in Accounts Payable.
  • Confident communication skills and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Experience handling supplier queries and resolving discrepancies.
  • Experience with expenses, accruals and VAT
  • Excel skills include pivot tables.
